1.3.57
- Much lighter on frame rate. The game builds its interface four times for every frame it shows, and the mod drew its pins, minimap and art in all four; now it draws only in the one that reaches the screen. The minimap's frame and the info bar's art (thousands of tiny rectangles, drawn even with the minimap hidden) and the boss icon are now a few ready-made images. On the test PC the HUD went from about 67 to 86 FPS (about 92 with the mod off), and the World Map with every filter on from about 35 to 48 FPS.
- The game's own names on the World Map (quests, rumors, spires and places) now always draw over the mod's pins, and pins under a hovered name no longer disappear.
- Moving the World Map no longer leaves gray squares around it while the desk art loads.
- Zoomed far out, place names near the edge of the world stay inside the World Map's frame instead of running onto the desk.
Reported bugs fixed:
- The mod cost 20 to 30 FPS during normal play, even with the minimap and every filter off. That cost is now much smaller. Reported by LordKeiran.
- Switching the mod off with Ctrl + Shift + F12 while the World Map was open could crash the game.
